scope: whitespace, punctuation, unicode, message-mode, abbreviation rules of sms-validation-demo

labelCorrections.what: Initial draft planted MISSING_WHITESPACE_AFTER_PUNCTUATION on the last char of a '!!!' run ('...online!!!So luong').
labelCorrections.whyCorrected: By design (comment in src/rules/punctuation-rules.mjs lines 78-80) a repeated-punct run never emits MISSING_WHITESPACE_AFTER_PUNCTUATION - not even at its final char; REPEATED_PUNCTUATION owns the whole run. This is engine-documented behavior, not a bug.
labelCorrections.resolution: Rewrote row to 'San sale online!!!Chot don ngay!Nhan qua' so the '!!!' run covers REPEATED_PUNCTUATION and a separate single '!Nhan' covers MISSING_WHITESPACE_AFTER_PUNCTUATION. Both expects caught.

labelCorrections.what: Double space directly before '.' overlaps MULTIPLE_WHITESPACE and WHITESPACE_BEFORE_PUNCTUATION spans exactly.
labelCorrections.whyCorrected: Engine conflict resolver (plan §25) keeps only the highest-priority/most-specific issue per identical span: WHITESPACE_BEFORE_PUNCTUATION (tiebreak 3) beats MULTIPLE_WHITESPACE (tiebreak 0). Labeled WHITESPACE_BEFORE_PUNCTUATION only.
labelCorrections.resolution: Label adjusted pre-scoring during probe phase; recorded as observation OBS-2a.

labelCorrections.what: Leading U+00A0: LEADING_WHITESPACE (/^\s+/ matches NBSP) and NON_BREAKING_SPACE share span [0,1).
labelCorrections.whyCorrected: Same-span conflict resolution keeps NON_BREAKING_SPACE (priority 550 > 400). Only one issue is emitted.
labelCorrections.resolution: Labeled NON_BREAKING_SPACE only; recorded as observation OBS-2b.

labelCorrections.what: Leading U+FEFF: JS \s includes U+FEFF, so LEADING_WHITESPACE and ZERO_WIDTH_CHARACTER share span [0,1).
labelCorrections.whyCorrected: ZERO_WIDTH_CHARACTER (priority 1000) wins the same-span conflict; no separate LEADING_WHITESPACE is emitted.
labelCorrections.resolution: Labeled ZERO_WIDTH_CHARACTER only; recorded as observation OBS-2c.

engineFindings.title: Mid-text TAB produces zero issues anywhere in the rule set
engineFindings.repro: Ma don hang	DH123456   (tab between 'hang' and 'DH123456', NON_ACCENTED)
engineFindings.expected: Arguably MULTIPLE_WHITESPACE for repeated/invisible whitespace in the body (or an INVALID_CHARACTER signal).
engineFindings.actual: No issue at all. MULTIPLE_WHITESPACE regex is ` {2,}` (ASCII spaces only, plan §11.4) and \t is in CONTROL_ALLOWED for INVALID_CHARACTER.
engineFindings.assessment: Spec-conformant today (§11.4 literally says ` {2,}`), but tabs survive the linter invisibly. Corpus row D05 locks this behavior as clean:true until product decides.

engineFindings.title: Same-span conflict resolution hides generic whitespace hints behind more specific rules
repros: D06 'Gia chi con 1000  .' -> only WHITESPACE_BEFORE_PUNCTUATION; MULTIPLE_WHITESPACE swallowed
D23 '\u00A0Xin chao cac ban' -> only NON_BREAKING_SPACE; LEADING_WHITESPACE swallowed
D25 '\uFEFFKhuyen mai cuoi tuan' -> only ZERO_WIDTH_CHARACTER; LEADING_WHITESPACE swallowed
engineFindings.expected-vs-actual: Each span still yields exactly one actionable warning, so nothing is silently missed by severity, but a user typing NBSP/BOM at position 0 never sees a 'leading whitespace' hint. Consistent with plan §25 (specific > generic); demo UI copy could mention it.

engineFindings.title: Repeated-punct runs suppress MISSING_WHITESPACE_AFTER_PUNCTUATION at run boundaries
engineFindings.repro: '...online!!!Chot' emits REPEATED_PUNCTUATION('!!!') only; no missing-space warning after the run.
engineFindings.expected-vs-actual: Matches the in-code comment (punctuation-rules.mjs lines 78-80): the run is owned by REPEATED_PUNCTUATION. Single-punct glue ('ngay!Nhan') still warns correctly.

Invariant honored: ZERO_WIDTH_CHARACTER fires even inside a protected URL (D24 'https://a.vn/x\u200Bid=10').
Ellipsis contract: exactly '...' allowed (D27 clean), '....' warns (D11). Initialism A.B.C needs no spaces while ',quy' style comma glue warns (D15 vs D07).
Abbreviation scoping exact: KH/KM/SDT fire under VT_TENDOO only (D29 vs D30); whole-token trap 'KHACH' does NOT match KH (D31 clean); CT/TT/KM/DV covered (D32).
NON_ACCENTED mode: accented token grouped per word as ERROR ('quý' in D26); legitimate unaccented Vietnamese produces no false accent/diacritic errors (D27).
Offset invariant text.substring(start,end)===value held for 38/38 issues across all 32 rows.
Clean-row discipline: 12/12 clean rows produced zero issues, i.e. no false positives from whitespace/punct/unicode/mode/abbreviation or the linguistic layer on curated lexicon-safe text.
